title: GLES1-on-GL2 layer missing features mean certain games only work on Android (which has native OpenGL ES)
labels: missing or incomplete iPhone OS API
author: backgamon
body:
### Describe the feature or issue.

Some games seems to only working on Android version of TouchHLE.
By ex:
Hero of Sparta.

On Windows build the game crash few seconds after launching with that error:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f0068213-b891-43c3-9897-5d7d9cca3220)

But on Android (with Noxplayer) games seem to run well.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49204b28-8312-493d-b6bd-1aa5b2fa5771)

The only thing are with controls making it unplayable.

comments.body:
This is thanks to @ciciplusplus's work in 629c5001ffdc41b83314e0ce81f4293af07b5d95.

We might need another issue for other limitations of the layer, but this was the biggest one so I'm fine with us closing it for now.
